meta.description: Project-specific config for the koolestpro-trend-radar skill. See docs/koolestpro-content-operating-plan.md Step 11 and CLAUDE.md's 'Trend & Format Radar — Export Routing' section. This file is what makes the skill portable — the Islamic content project (or any future project) gets its own copy of this file with different pillars/keywords/paths, the skill's own logic stays identical.

x.note: Shares Ridwan's existing $5-7/month X credit pool with Make.com posting. Raise maxReadsPerWeek before raising cadence if more volume is needed, per Step 11.

reddit.note: Blocked until Ridwan signs up for a third-party Reddit read API provider (Reddit's own official API floors at $12,000/year). Set REDDIT_API_BASE_URL / REDDIT_API_TOKEN in .env once chosen — no code changes needed, see reddit_search.py.

instagram.disabledReason: 2026-09-18: paused during the Instagram 'automated behaviour' warning investigation. Browsing Instagram with an automated browser inside Ridwan's logged-in Chrome is exactly what that warning targets. Do not re-enable without Ridwan's explicit OK.
instagram.note: No trend-discovery API exists for Instagram (confirmed 2026-07-30). Supplementary signal only, may not run reliably inside an unattended scheduled task — degrade gracefully if so.
